- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:671-693 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: In check_one(), on the cut-off branch, the code can throw away a run. This happens when the runs page is truncated and the targeted `&head_sha=<merge sha>` read finds no run on the merge commit. The code sets `fresh = None; run = None; truncated = True` and drops the descendant-commit run that `select_run` already picked, so `compare/<merge>...<head>` never checks whether that run contains the merge.
  WHY: The candidate stays `pending reason=runs_truncated` until the window passes and then ends `unverified reason=runs_truncated`, when it could have been graded held or recurred. Both flagging reviewers rated it MAJOR (mapped to high). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash checked this claim and rejected it as intended, documented behaviour: grading `fresh` could give a false `held` and would break P5's "first completed run ... whose head_sha contains merge_sha".

  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In test_check_recurred_from_failed_job_reopens_in_planning, the comment "within 1 + 8 x MAX_PER_TICK." and the assertion `len(fake.calls) <= 1 + 8 * 3` are stale. The module docstring and the agents.d/8427-p5-persist-postmerge-verify.md API-budget bullet now say 1 + 9 x MAX_PER_TICK, because the targeted `head_sha` read was added.
  WHY: Nothing fails at runtime (this path makes 8 calls), but the test no longer guards the documented budget, so a future budget regression could pass. All four reviewers rated it NIT (mapped to low).
